metadata.description: 100 天英文式思考、語塊預測 (Chunks) 與抗恐慌影子跟讀 (Shadowing) 全域總資料庫 - 完整 1000 塊

phases.title: 破除逐字直譯與生存破冰 (Survival & Discarding Word-by-Word Translation)
phases.core_focus: 殺死大腦中英直譯心算延遲，建立自然破冰反問、打斷與確認理解的生存求救工具。

phases.title: 連音形變與聽力預測力 (Fast Speech Shapes & Auditory Prediction)
phases.core_focus: 掌握母語人士快速連音弱化 (Flap-T, have弱化, 顎化)，聽懂音樂性語調與話題無縫切換。

phases.title: 觀點碰撞與委婉折衷 (Nuanced Expression & Soft Pushback)
phases.core_focus: 高情商表達不同觀點，先接納再反對，禮貌爭取發言權與引導深入說明。

phases.title: 高壓職場應變與專業說服 (High-Pressure Workplace & Persuasion)
phases.core_focus: 跨國敏捷早會匯報、風險預警、推動下一步、化解客訴、10分鐘無中文介入交流。

phases.title: 母語直覺、幽默與即興流暢 (Native Intuition & Improvisation)
phases.core_focus: 地道美式諺語隱喻、幽默化解尷尬、情緒共鳴、徹底完成英文思維大腦質變。

syllabus_100_days.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
委婉立場與話題自然推進
會議禮貌插話與澄清盲點
高階同意與豁達心態
週進度結算與下週約定
線上會議連線與音訊排查
餐敘點餐與社交破冰
第 1 階段首期驗收與卡頓庫盤點
重述對方意圖的錨點語塊
面對尖銳問題的情緒降溫
拒絕不合理要求的委婉起手式
如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
表達模糊記憶與不完全承諾
優雅結束話題並脫身的台階句
【第一階段大考驗】200 塊生存盲測
What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
將扯遠的話題拉回主線
插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
對話結尾前的最後總括
憑印象估算的自保守則
據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
未經證實傳言的保留態度
為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
表達深有同感 (Tell me about it)
安撫同仁挫折情緒 (Hang in there)
讚揚對方洞見 (You have a point)
分享共同經歷的辛酸與無奈
【第二階段大考驗】400 塊連音盲聽
高情商先肯定再轉折 (Yes, but)
提出建設性批評的打預防針句
以客觀數據替代主觀情緒批評
化解跨部門爭議的中立立場句
表達底線但維持夥伴友好
會議收斂：說到底核心是什麼
評估最壞打算與風險承受度
聚焦唯一關鍵指標 (North Star)
在有限資源下的優先級取捨
達成協議與彼此退讓折衷
多人會議搶麥克風的禮貌句
煞車及時確認關鍵數據再前進
補充遺漏重點的快速過渡詞
委婉指正他人記憶中的偏差
被插話後重新拿回主導權
要求對方逐步走一遍流程 (Walk through)
拆解複雜架構為簡易模組
確認各利害關係人的負責範圍
以具體案例說明抽象理論
【第三階段大考驗】600 塊觀點交涉
敏捷早會 30 秒俐落進度匯報
清楚陳述阻礙與相依性 (Blocker)
主動尋求跨組協作與資源支援
進度跟進與事後線下對齊 (Take offline)
承諾下次碰面檢視成果 (Touch base)
誠實說明專案延期的專業口氣
面對客戶抱怨時的致歉與挽回
突發系統異常的緊急通報語塊
安撫合作夥伴並提供替代路徑
危機解除後的檢討與後續追蹤
簡報開場抓住觀眾注意力的鉤子
圖表與數據呈現時的轉折詞
處理簡報 Q&A 棘手發問的擋箭牌
簡報結論與號召行動 (Call to Action)
超時控制與禮貌打圓場
商務報價談判中的心理博弈
相互讓步的雙贏談判句 (Give and take)
為公司爭取更多權益的試探性提問
最終拍板定案的專業用語
【第四階段大考驗】800 塊高壓模擬
開門見山直接切題 (Cut to the chase)
話到嘴邊與記憶喚起 (Tip of my tongue)
隨機應變看情況行事 (Play it by ear)
大度不記仇的豁達 (No hard feelings)
見好就收宣布下班 (Call it a day)
接受無法改變的客觀事實 (It is what it is)
幽默自嘲與化解全場緊繃氛圍
讚美他人做到極致 (You nailed it)
表達難以抉擇的糾結 (Torn between)
以輕鬆幽默方式結識新朋友
跨文化英式幽默 vs 美式幽默差異
生活比喻與美式運動隱喻 (Touch base, Curveball)
美食、電影與流行文化深入探討
深度哲學與職涯價值觀探討語塊
表達真摯感謝與深層人際連結
【衝刺日 1】高頻 100 塊盲聽盲答總集結
【衝刺日 2】卡頓句型庫零死角終極清空
【衝刺日 3】全隨機速度 1.25x 壓力生存挑戰
【衝刺日 4】15 分鐘全英語盲測 Role-play 實戰
【第 100 天巔峰里程碑】突破 1000 塊 • 內化直覺英語大腦！

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: How's it going?
chunks.literalMeaning: 它正在如何走？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 最近過得如何？最近好嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: How'zit goin'? [/haʊzɪt ˈɡoʊɪn/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: How is 縮合成 How's，與 it 連音形成 /haʊzɪt/。

dialogue.speakerA: Hey! Good to see you in the hallway!
dialogue.speakerB: How's it going?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: What have you been up to?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你一直直到上面在做什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你最近在忙些什麼呀？有什麼新鮮事嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: What'cha been up to? [/ˈwʌtʃə bɪn ʌp tuː/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: have 弱化脫落，What+you 顎化發出 /tʃə/。

dialogue.speakerA: I haven't seen you around the office lately!
dialogue.speakerB: What have you been up to?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: Good to finally meet you in person.
chunks.literalMeaning: 好的去最後遇見你在人身上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 很高興終於見到你本人了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Good ta finally meetcha in person.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: meet you 連讀顎化為 meetcha /miːtʃə/。

dialogue.speakerA: Hi, I'm Alex from the Seattle design team.
dialogue.speakerB: Good to finally meet you in person.

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: How's your week been treating you?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你的週一直如何對待你？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這星期過得還順心嗎？這週還好吧？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: How's yer week been treatin' ya?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: your 弱化為 yer，treating 字尾 g 脫落。

dialogue.speakerA: Happy Wednesday! How are things on your end?
dialogue.speakerB: How's your week been treating you?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: I haven't seen you around lately.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我最近沒有在周圍看到你。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 最近都沒怎麼在辦公室看到你耶！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I haven' seen ya 'round lately.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: around 吞音變 'round。

dialogue.speakerA: Hey there! Been working remotely lately?
dialogue.speakerB: I haven't seen you around lately.

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: Did you catch the news about the new policy?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你有抓住那個新聞關於新政策嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你有看到/聽說關於新政策的那則新聞嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Didja catch the news 'bout the new policy?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Did you 自然連讀為 Didja。

dialogue.speakerA: Did HR send out an announcement this morning?
dialogue.speakerB: Did you catch the news about the new policy?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: What brings you to our floor today?
chunks.literalMeaning: 什麼帶你到我們樓層今天？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 今天是什麼風把你吹來我們這層樓啦？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: What brings ya ta our floor t'day?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 比 Why are you here 禮貌親切一百倍。

dialogue.speakerA: Hey! I usually only see you in the cafeteria!
dialogue.speakerB: What brings you to our floor today?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: Are you free for a quick coffee catch-up?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你是自由的為了一個快速咖啡追趕嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你現在方便抽空下樓喝杯咖啡聊聊嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ya free fer a quick coffee catch-up?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: for a 連音變 fer a。

dialogue.speakerA: I have a quick idea about our joint marketing campaign.
dialogue.speakerB: Are you free for a quick coffee catch-up?

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: I'll let you get back to your work.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將讓你回到你的工作。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我就不打擾你了，你趕緊先忙手頭工作吧！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'll letcha get back ta yer work.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: let you 顎化為 letcha；優雅脫身神句。

dialogue.speakerA: Thanks for chatting, I see you have a document open.
dialogue.speakerB: I'll let you get back to your work.

chunks.topic: 經典破冰與反向發球
chunks.text: Catch you later around the office!
chunks.literalMeaning: 稍後抓住你在辦公室周圍！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 回頭見！下次在辦公室遇到再聊！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Catcha later 'round the office!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Catch you 縮略為 Catcha。

dialogue.speakerA: Alright, my Zoom meeting starts in two minutes.
dialogue.speakerB: Catch you later around the office!

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: I'm not sure I follow.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我不確定我跟隨。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我不太明白你的意思 / 有點沒跟上你的思路。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'm not sure I follow. [/aɪm nɑːt ʃʊr aɪ ˈfɑːloʊ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: not sure 稍作停頓，語氣誠懇從容不卑微。

dialogue.speakerA: We must refactor the decoupled idempotent RPC microservice protocol.
dialogue.speakerB: I'm not sure I follow.

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Let me make sure I understand.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我確認我理解。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 讓我確認一下我有沒有理解正確。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme make sure I understan'.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Let me 連音為 Lemme；搶回控制權黃金起手式。

dialogue.speakerA: So the client demands all 20 reports delivered before Friday noon.
dialogue.speakerB: Let me make sure I understand.

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Sorry, I missed the last part.
chunks.literalMeaning: 抱歉，我錯過了最後的部分。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 不好意思，你最後那句話我沒聽清楚，可以重述嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Sorry, I missed the las' part.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 坦承只漏後半句，展現全程高度參與。

dialogue.speakerA: We need to rotate the AWS IAM tokens because edge nodes timed out.
dialogue.speakerB: Sorry, I missed the last part.

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Could you explain that another way?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你能用另一種方式解釋那個嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你可以換個通俗的方式說明一下嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Couldja explain that 'nother way?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Could you 顎化為 Couldja；逼對方簡化語言。

dialogue.speakerA: The polymorphic inheritance hierarchy breaks Liskov substitution.
dialogue.speakerB: Could you explain that another way?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: What you're saying is, we need more time?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在說的是，我們需要更多時間？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 所以你的意思是說...我們實質上需要更多時間？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: What yer sayin' is, we need more time?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: you're 弱化為 yer；重述對方意圖定盤。

dialogue.speakerA: Our team has encountered three major architectural blockers this week.
dialogue.speakerB: What you're saying is, we need more time?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Are you saying that the deadline moved?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在說那個截止線移動了嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你的意思是說交付死期提前了嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ya sayin' that the deadline moved?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Are you 略成 Ya；快速驗證關鍵推論。

dialogue.speakerA: Marketing announced the launch date as Wednesday instead of Friday.
dialogue.speakerB: Are you saying that the deadline moved?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Come again, please?
chunks.literalMeaning: 再來一次，請？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 不好意思，你剛才說什麼？麻煩再說一次好嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: C'm again, please? [/kəm əˈɡen/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Come 弱化吞音，比 What 禮貌且地道十倍。

dialogue.speakerA: The third-party server just threw a 504 gateway timeout error.
dialogue.speakerB: Come again, please?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Am I making any sense to you?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我正在製造任何感覺對你嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我有講清楚嗎？我這樣表達通順明白嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Am I makin' any sense t'ya?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 主動承擔溝通成本，體貼親和。

dialogue.speakerA: I explained the complex state machine architecture for five minutes.
dialogue.speakerB: Am I making any sense to you?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Do you know what I mean?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你知道我意味著什麼嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你懂我意思吧？能明白那種感覺嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ya know what I mean?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 拉近距離的超高頻對話確認口頭禪。

dialogue.speakerA: It feels like our codebase is getting too fragmented lately.
dialogue.speakerB: Do you know what I mean?

chunks.topic: 聽不懂時的免恐慌叫停
chunks.text: Does that make sense from your perspective?
chunks.literalMeaning: 那有製造道理從你的視角嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 從你那邊的視角來看，這樣講合理順暢嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Does that make sense from yer perspective?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 邀請對方給予回饋確認共識。

dialogue.speakerA: We propose shipping the core API first, and the UI next Monday.
dialogue.speakerB: Does that make sense from your perspective?

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: Let me think for a second.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我思考為了一秒。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 讓我想一下喔...（從容爭取 5-10 秒組織語言）
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme think fer a second.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: for a 連音變 fer a；絕不因沉默而恐慌。

dialogue.speakerA: Why did our conversion rate drop by 15% last Tuesday?
dialogue.speakerB: Let me think for a second.

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: That's a really good question.
chunks.literalMeaning: 那是一個非常好的問題。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這問題問得真好！（優雅爭取 3 秒思考對策）
chunks.fastSpeechShape: That's a really good question.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: really 音節拉長強調，心理優勢立現。

dialogue.speakerA: How do you plan to scale our customer support without hiring more staff?
dialogue.speakerB: That's a really good question.

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: How should I put this?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我應該如何放置這個？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 該怎麼說比較好呢... / 我該如何表達比較貼切呢？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: How should I put this?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 展現謹慎措辭的專業高管姿態。

dialogue.speakerA: Why did your team miss the sprint delivery milestone?
dialogue.speakerB: How should I put this?

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: Off the top of my head, I'd say around twenty.
chunks.literalMeaning: 脫離我頭的頂部，我會說大約二十。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 憑直覺想到的話 / 憑記憶不查資料的話，大概二十個吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Off the top of my head, I'd say 'round twenty.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: top of 連讀為 /tɑːpəv/；免責防衛必備。

dialogue.speakerA: How many enterprise clients are currently using our beta feature?
dialogue.speakerB: Off the top of my head, I'd say around twenty.

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: To be completely honest with you...
chunks.literalMeaning: 為了是完全誠實與你...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 坦白跟您說吧 / 說句心裡掏心窩的話...
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta be completely hones' with ya...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: honest 的 t 弱化；贏得尊重的真誠起手式。

dialogue.speakerA: Can we really ship this software update without bugs on Friday?
dialogue.speakerB: To be completely honest with you...

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: As far as I know, the server is stable.
chunks.literalMeaning: 就如遠如同我知道...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 就我目前所知 / 據我了解，伺服器運轉正常。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As far as I know, the server's stable.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: far as I 連讀形成 /fɑːrəzaɪ/。

dialogue.speakerA: Is the payment gateway still experiencing intermittent downtime?
dialogue.speakerB: As far as I know, the server is stable.

chunks.topic: 爭取思考時間的黃金緩衝
chunks.text: The thing is, we're waiting on legal approval.

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: That was an oversight on my part, I'll fix it immediately.
chunks.literalMeaning: 那是個疏忽在我的部分上，我將修復它立即地。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 那確實是我個人工作上的疏忽失察，我這就立刻動手修正它！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: That was an oversight on my part, I'll fix it immediately.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: oversight 疏忽失察 /oʊ.vɚ.saɪt/，高格調職場承擔措辭。

dialogue.speakerA: The client noticed their company name was misspelled on slide three.
dialogue.speakerB: That was an oversight on my part, I'll fix it immediately.

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: I misread the calendar, thanks for catching that!
chunks.literalMeaning: 我誤讀了日曆，謝謝為了抓住那個！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 是我粗心看錯行事曆日期了，太感謝你眼尖及時抓出這個錯誤！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I misread the calendar, thanks fer catchin' that!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 把被指正轉化為對對方的由衷讚許。

dialogue.speakerA: The client call is at 3 PM tomorrow, not today!
dialogue.speakerB: I misread the calendar, thanks for catching that!

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: Pardon the brain freeze, let me gather my thoughts.
chunks.literalMeaning: 原諒大腦凍結，讓我聚集我的思想。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 抱歉大腦剛才突然冰凍當機了一下，讓我花三秒鐘稍微組織梳理一下思緒。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Pardon the brain freeze, lemme gather my thoughts.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: gather my thoughts 沉著重組語言的優雅動作。

dialogue.speakerA: The VP asked a very complex multi-layered financial question.
dialogue.speakerB: Pardon the brain freeze, let me gather my thoughts.

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: I take full responsibility for that broken link.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我拿完全責任為了那個壞鏈接。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 那個失效損壞的網頁連結是我負責的，我承擔全部責任！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I take full responsibility fer that broken link.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 絕不推諉卸責給實習生，展現男子漢擔當。

dialogue.speakerA: Who deployed the newsletter with the non-clickable signup button?
dialogue.speakerB: I take full responsibility for that broken link.

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: Well, nobody's perfect! Let's correct it and move on.
chunks.literalMeaning: 好吧，沒有人是完美的！讓我們糾正它且移動向前。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 哎呀，人非聖賢孰能無過嘛！我們趕緊修正改進，繼續大步往前邁進！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Well, nobody's perfect! Let's correct it an' move on.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: nobody's perfect 迅速翻篇，絕不沉溺內疚內耗。

dialogue.speakerA: You accidentally pushed test code into the development branch.
dialogue.speakerB: Well, nobody's perfect! Let's correct it and move on.

chunks.topic: 如何承認忘詞與失誤而不尷尬
chunks.text: Thanks for your patience while I get my bearings.
chunks.literalMeaning: 謝謝為了你的耐心當我得到我的方位時。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 感謝大家耐心的包容與等待，我已經重新找回我的方向與節奏了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Thanks fer yer patience while I get my bearings.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: get my bearings 重新找回羅盤方位座標。

dialogue.speakerA: You opened the wrong folder and took 10 seconds to locate the presentation.
dialogue.speakerB: Thanks for your patience while I get my bearings.

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: How does that sound to everyone on the call?
chunks.literalMeaning: 那個如何聽起來對每個人在通話上？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 線上與會的各位夥伴，大家聽起來覺得這個提議如何呢？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: How does that sound ta everyone on the call?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 最經典、最受歡迎的徵詢回饋開場白。

dialogue.speakerA: I propose we shorten all daily standup meetings to 15 minutes.
dialogue.speakerB: How does that sound to everyone on the call?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Does anyone have any thoughts or pushback on this?
chunks.literalMeaning: 任何人有任何思想或推回在這個上面嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在座夥伴有任何想法，或有任何想提出反面意見的嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Does anyone have any thoughts or pushback on this?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 主動歡迎反面意見 (Pushback)，展現開放包容的領導力。

dialogue.speakerA: We are considering migrating our production servers to Google Cloud.
dialogue.speakerB: Does anyone have any thoughts or pushback on this?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Does that resonate with what you're seeing in the market?
chunks.literalMeaning: 那有共鳴與你在市場看見的嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這跟你們在市場第一線所親眼目睹的實際現況有產生共鳴吻合嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Does that resonate with what yer seein' in the market?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: resonate with 產生深刻共鳴 /rez.ən.eɪt/。

dialogue.speakerA: Our research indicates customer demand for AI tools is skyrocketing.
dialogue.speakerB: Does that resonate with what you're seeing in the market?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: I'd love to hear your perspective on this, Alex.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我會喜愛去聽你的視角在這個上，Alex。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 針對這點，我非常想特別請教聽聽看 Alex 您的專業高見與視角！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'd love ta hear yer perspective on this, Alex.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 點名邀請內向但有實力的專家發言。

dialogue.speakerA: We are discussing the new microservices security architecture.
dialogue.speakerB: I'd love to hear your perspective on this, Alex.

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: What's your gut reaction to this proposal?
chunks.literalMeaning: 什麼是你的腸子反應對這提議？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 看到這份全新提案，你第一時間下意識的直覺本能反應是什麼？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: What's yer gut reaction ta this proposal?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: gut reaction 直覺本能反應，挖掘最真實想法。

dialogue.speakerA: We just unveiled the new brand logo and minimalist color scheme.
dialogue.speakerB: What's your gut reaction to this proposal?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Are there any glaring holes in this plan that I missed?
chunks.literalMeaning: 有任何閃耀的洞在這計畫裡我錯過了？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在這份作戰計畫裡，有沒有哪些我剛好瞎了眼遺漏掉的顯眼大漏洞？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Are there any glaring holes in this plan that I missed?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: glaring holes 耀眼刺眼的大漏洞；主動求挑刺。

dialogue.speakerA: I spent three days designing our holiday deployment roadmap.
dialogue.speakerB: Are there any glaring holes in this plan that I missed?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Do we have consensus on moving forward with option B?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我們擁有共識在移動向前帶著選項B嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 針對全力採取 B 方案推進這件事，我們全體同仁達成正式共識了嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Do we have consensus on movin' forward with option B?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: consensus 全員共識 /kənˈsen.səs/，拍板前確認。

dialogue.speakerA: Both option A and B have been debated thoroughly for an hour.
dialogue.speakerB: Do we have consensus on moving forward with option B?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Feel free to poke holes in this initial draft.
chunks.literalMeaning: 感覺自由去戳洞在這初始草案裡。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這純粹是初稿，大家千萬別客氣，儘管用力幫我挑毛病戳洞找碴！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Feel free ta poke holes in this initial draft.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: poke holes 歡迎大家挑刺完善方案。

dialogue.speakerA: I just published the preliminary API specification draft on Notion.
dialogue.speakerB: Feel free to poke holes in this initial draft.

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Is there anything here that makes you uncomfortable?
chunks.literalMeaning: 有任何事情在這裡製造你不太舒適嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在這份協議條款當中，有沒有任何讓您感到不太踏實或不太自在的地方？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Is there anything here that makes ya uncomfortable?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 洞察對方潛在未說出口的疑慮防線。

dialogue.speakerA: We reviewed the proposed three-year vendor exclusivity agreement.
dialogue.speakerB: Is there anything here that makes you uncomfortable?

chunks.topic: 邀請對方給予反饋與共識確認
chunks.text: Can everyone give a quick thumbs-up if this works?
chunks.literalMeaning: 每個人能給一個快速大拇指向上如果這工作嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 如果大家都覺得這樣安排可行，能麻煩大家在鏡頭前比個大拇指確認嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Can everyone give a quick thumbs-up if this works?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: thumbs-up 視訊會議最直觀高互動的確認手法。

dialogue.speakerA: So we agree to reschedule our Thursday meeting to Friday 10 AM?
dialogue.speakerB: Can everyone give a quick thumbs-up if this works?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Fancy running into you here! How've you been?
chunks.literalMeaning: 幻想奔跑進你這裡！你一直如何？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 真巧啊！竟然會在這裡巧遇到你！最近過得還好嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Fancy runnin' into ya here! How've ya been?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: fancy running into you 偶遇巧遇最地道的英美寒暄語。

dialogue.speakerA: You bump into a colleague in the elevator lobby on the 10th floor.
dialogue.speakerB: Fancy running into you here! How've you been?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Long time no see! What are you working on these days?
chunks.literalMeaning: 長時間沒有看見！你在工作什麼在這些日子？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 好久不見啦！你這陣子都在忙些什麼厲害的專案呀？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Long time no see! What're ya workin' on these days?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 熱情打破許久未見的生疏感。

dialogue.speakerA: You run into a former teammate who moved to the London office.
dialogue.speakerB: Long time no see! What are you working on these days?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Just grabbing my third cup of coffee to survive the day!
chunks.literalMeaning: 只是抓我第三杯咖啡去生存這天！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 純粹跑來倒今天第三杯黑咖啡續命，才能勉強熬過今天啦！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Just grabbin' my third cup of coffee ta survive!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 咖啡因打工人自嘲共鳴法寶。

dialogue.speakerA: Hey! What brings you to the cafeteria at 3 PM?
dialogue.speakerB: Just grabbing my third cup of coffee to survive the day!

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Heading to the all-hands meeting right now?
chunks.literalMeaning: 前進到所有手會議剛好現在？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你現在也是正準備動身走去參加全體員工大會 (All-hands) 嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Headin' ta the all-hands right now?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 結伴同行最順勢自然的破冰問句。

dialogue.speakerA: You see your colleague walking toward the main auditorium.
dialogue.speakerB: Heading to the all-hands meeting right now?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Did you have a relaxing weekend? Do anything fun?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你有一個放鬆的週末嗎？做任何有趣的事嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 週末過得還放鬆愜意嗎？有沒有跑去哪裡玩什麼好玩的？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Didja have a relaxing weekend? Do anything fun?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 週一晨間走廊最經典的暖心問候。

dialogue.speakerA: It's Monday morning at 9:30 AM in the kitchen pantry.
dialogue.speakerB: Did you have a relaxing weekend? Do anything fun?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: I love your laptop sticker, where did you get that?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我愛你的筆記型電腦貼紙，你在哪裡得到那個？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我超喜歡你筆記型電腦背後貼的那張貼紙耶！你在哪裡拿到的？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I love yer laptop sticker, where'dja get that?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 觀察個人物品小細節，瞬間破冰建立話題。

dialogue.speakerA: You notice a cool retro pixel-art dinosaur sticker on their MacBook.
dialogue.speakerB: I love your laptop sticker, where did you get that?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Are you surviving the Q4 planning madness?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在生存第四季計畫瘋狂嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你這陣子有平安熬過第四季瘋狂的年度規劃風暴嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Are ya survivin' the Q4 planning madness?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 共同吐槽繁重業務壓力，最快拉近革命情感。

dialogue.speakerA: Everyone in the company is busy writing annual strategy documents.
dialogue.speakerB: Are you surviving the Q4 planning madness?

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: I'll let you get your coffee, catch you later around!
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將讓你得到你的咖啡，稍後抓住你在周圍！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 好啦我不耽誤你倒咖啡了，你先忙，回頭辦公室遇到再聊！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'll letcha get yer coffee, catcha later around!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 見好就收，絕不霸佔他人私人放鬆時間。

dialogue.speakerA: Thanks for chatting, I really need to brew this espresso!
dialogue.speakerB: I'll let you get your coffee, catch you later around!

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Don't work too hard today, remember to take breaks!
chunks.literalMeaning: 不要工作太硬今天，記住去拿休息！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 今天可千萬別太拚命賣命加班喔，記得適時休息放鬆一下！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Don't work too hard t'day, remember ta take breaks!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 充滿人情味的溫暖關懷。

dialogue.speakerA: Your colleague is rubbing their temples looking slightly stressed.
dialogue.speakerB: Don't work too hard today, remember to take breaks!

chunks.topic: 辦公室走廊隨機巧遇寒暄
chunks.text: Great to see you in person instead of a Zoom square!
chunks.literalMeaning: 偉大去遇見你在人身上代替一個Zoom正方形！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 能親眼見到你大活人本人，而不是隔著 Zoom 的小方框，真是太棒了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Great ta see ya in person instead of a Zoom square!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 遠距混和辦公時代最具共鳴的幽默寒暄。

dialogue.speakerA: You meet a colleague at the annual corporate retreat.
dialogue.speakerB: Great to see you in person instead of a Zoom square!

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Let me share my screen, give me just a second.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我分享我的螢幕，給我剛好一秒。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我來分享一下我的電腦螢幕畫面，麻煩稍等我一下下喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme share my screen, gimme just a second.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 螢幕分享標準墊檔口頭禪，消除沉默恐慌。

dialogue.speakerA: It's your turn to present the slide deck during the team meeting.
dialogue.speakerB: Let me share my screen, give me just a second.

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Can everyone see the slides clearly on your end?
chunks.literalMeaning: 每個人能看見投影片清楚地在你的末端嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 大家在你們各自的螢幕那端，都能清晰看見這份投影片嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Can everyone see the slides clearly on yer end?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 確認觀眾已同步載入畫面。

dialogue.speakerA: The slides just transitioned to full-screen presenter mode.
dialogue.speakerB: Can everyone see the slides clearly on your end?

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Bear with me while the dashboard loads up.
chunks.literalMeaning: 忍受與我當儀表板載入向上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 後台數據儀表板正在載入中，大家稍等我片刻喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Bear with me while the dashboard loads up.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 系統卡頓載入時的最佳禮貌墊檔詞。

dialogue.speakerA: The heavy analytics dashboard takes 5 seconds to render.
dialogue.speakerB: Bear with me while the dashboard loads up.

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Let me zoom in so the font is readable for everyone.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我放大所以字體是可讀的為了每個人。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我把畫面稍微放大一點，這樣字體對每個人來說才夠清晰好讀。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme zoom in so the font is readable fer everyone.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: zoom in 放大；體貼後排或手機端觀眾體驗。

dialogue.speakerA: The terminal code font appears a bit small on the shared screen.
dialogue.speakerB: Let me zoom in so the font is readable for everyone.

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: I have too many tabs open, let me find the right window!
chunks.literalMeaning: 我擁有太多標籤打開，讓我找到正確視窗！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我瀏覽器開了太多分頁標籤了，讓我找一下剛才那個正確視窗！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I have too many tabs open, lemme find the right window!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 幽默自嘲翻找視窗時的短暫空白。

dialogue.speakerA: You are hunting through 40 Chrome tabs to find the Figma design file.
dialogue.speakerB: I have too many tabs open, let me find the right window!

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: I'll put the link directly in the Zoom chat for reference.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將放這鏈接直接地在Zoom聊天裡為了參考。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我把這個檔案連結直接貼進 Zoom 聊天室裡，供大家參考查閱。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'll put the link in the chat fer reference.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 同步提供文字資源，展現專業細緻。

dialogue.speakerA: Attendees want to click and interact with the live prototype.
dialogue.speakerB: I'll put the link directly in the Zoom chat for reference.

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Let me stop sharing for a moment while I enter my password.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我停止分享為了一時刻當我輸入我的密碼。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 容我先暫時停止螢幕分享一下下，好讓我安全輸入內部密碼。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme stop sharin' fer a moment while I enter my password.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 守護資安與個人隱私的專業規範動作。

dialogue.speakerA: You need to log into the corporate production console.
dialogue.speakerB: Let me stop sharing for a moment while I enter my password.

chunks.topic: 視訊分享螢幕時的操作墊檔詞
chunks.text: Is the video playback coming through with sound?
chunks.literalMeaning: 是影片播放穿過來帶著聲音嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 請問剛才這段影片播放時，大家聽得到裡面的聲音嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Is the video playback comin' through with sound?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 確認視訊軟體有勾選『分享電腦聲音』。

dialogue.speakerA: You just started playing a customer interview video clip.
dialogue.speakerB: Is the video playback coming through with sound?

chunks.text: Anyway, I know you're super busy, I'll let you get back to it!
