dialogue.speakerA: Are you ready to dive into fast speech shapes like 'Whatcha' and 'woulda'?
dialogue.speakerB: Ready for Phase 2: Mastering connected speech and sound shifts!

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: Whatcha gonna do about the deadline?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你將要做什麼關於截止線？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你打算拿這個交付死期怎麼辦？有何對策？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha gonna do 'bout the deadline? [/ˈwʌtʃə ˈɡənə duː baʊt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: What are you 顎化縮讀為 Whatcha /wʌtʃə/，about 吞音為 'bout。

dialogue.speakerA: The client moved the deployment deadline to tomorrow morning!
dialogue.speakerB: Whatcha gonna do about the deadline?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you talking about?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在談論什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你到底在說什麼呀？（驚訝或質疑）
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whaddya talkin' 'bout? [/ˈwʌdjə ˈtɔːkɪn baʊt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: What are you 弱化為 Whaddya，talking 字尾 g 脫落。

dialogue.speakerA: I heard the CEO is stepping down next week.
dialogue.speakerB: What are you talking about?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: Whatcha got there?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你得到那裡什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你手裡拿的是什麼好東西呀？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha got there? [/ˈwʌtʃə ɡɑːt ðer/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 辦公室走廊打招呼常用句，親切隨和。

dialogue.speakerA: I just brought back a box from the local bakery.
dialogue.speakerB: Whatcha got there?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you up to this weekend?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你這週末一直直到什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你這個週末有什麼安排或計畫嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whaddya up to this weekend? [/ˈwʌdjə ʌp tuː/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 週五同事間破冰下班問候最經典語塊。

dialogue.speakerA: Happy Friday! Any big plans coming up?
dialogue.speakerB: What are you up to this weekend?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you trying to say exactly?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在嘗試去說什麼精確地？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你究竟是想表達什麼意思？請明說。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha tryin' ta say exactly?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: trying to 弱讀為 tryin' ta；語氣直切核心。

dialogue.speakerA: Our roadmap has some ambiguous dependencies that worry me.
dialogue.speakerB: What are you trying to say exactly?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: Whatcha think of the new design?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你認為新設計什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你覺得這個新介面設計怎麼樣？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha think of the new design?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: think of 連讀為 /θɪŋkəv/。

dialogue.speakerA: Here is the latest prototype for the landing page.
dialogue.speakerB: Whatcha think of the new design?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在等待為了什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你還在等什麼？我們出發吧！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whaddya waitin' fer? Let's go!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: waiting for 連讀為 waitin' fer。

dialogue.speakerA: The lunch rush is starting at the noodle bar downstairs.
dialogue.speakerB: What are you waiting for? Let's go!

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you looking at so intently?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在看著什麼如此專注地？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你看什麼看這麼入神啊？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha lookin' at so intently?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: looking at 連讀為 lookin' at。

dialogue.speakerA: I'm analyzing our real-time traffic spike on Google Analytics.
dialogue.speakerB: What are you looking at so intently?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: Whatcha need help with right now?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你現在需要幫助與什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你現在最需要哪一方面的協助？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whatcha need help with right now?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 主動伸出援手的溫暖問候。

dialogue.speakerA: I have three tickets assigned to me due by 5 PM.
dialogue.speakerB: Whatcha need help with right now?

chunks.topic: What are you gonna do 縮讀弱化
chunks.text: What are you planning on telling them?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你正在計畫在告訴他們什麼？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你打算怎麼跟他們解釋這件事？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whaddya plannin' on tellin' 'em?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: them 弱讀為 'em /əm/。

dialogue.speakerA: The board called an unexpected emergency sync.
dialogue.speakerB: What are you planning on telling them?

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: I would have told you if I knew.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將已經告訴你如果我知道。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 如果我早知道，我早就告訴你了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I woulda toldja if I knew. [/aɪ ˈwʊdə ˈtoʊldʒə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: would have 弱化為 woulda，told you 顎化為 toldja。

dialogue.speakerA: Why didn't you mention that the VP was visiting today?
dialogue.speakerB: I would have told you if I knew.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: You should have seen his face!
chunks.literalMeaning: 你應該已經看見他的臉！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你真該看看他當時驚呆的表情！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: You shoulda seen his face! [/juː ˈʃʊdə siːn/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: should have 弱化為 shoulda；生動分享八卦必備。

dialogue.speakerA: How did Tom react when our team won the hackathon?
dialogue.speakerB: You should have seen his face!

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: It could have been a lot worse.
chunks.literalMeaning: 它能已經是一很多更壞。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 坦白說，情況本來可能會糟糕得多的。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: It coulda been a lot worse. [/ɪt ˈkʊdə bɪn/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: could have 弱化為 coulda；安慰並引導樂觀視角。

dialogue.speakerA: Our production server went down for twelve minutes today.
dialogue.speakerB: It could have been a lot worse.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: We should have done this a month ago.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我們應該已經做這個一個月前。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我們一個月前就該這麼做了（早該這樣了）！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: We shoulda done this a month ago.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 表示對拖延決策的事後感慨。

dialogue.speakerA: Automating this report saves our team four hours every Monday!
dialogue.speakerB: We should have done this a month ago.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: I would have loved to join you, but I'm swamped.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將已經喜愛去加入你，但我被淹沒。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我很想去跟你們一起，但我現在實在忙翻了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I woulda loved ta join ya, but I'm swamped.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: would have loved to 縮讀為 woulda loved ta；高情商婉拒。

dialogue.speakerA: A group of us are heading to the sushi bistro for lunch!
dialogue.speakerB: I would have loved to join you, but I'm swamped.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: You could have asked for help earlier.
chunks.literalMeaning: 你能夠已經要求為了幫助更早。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你早就可以找我們幫忙的呀（不必自己硬扛）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: You coulda asked fer help earlier.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: could have asked 縮讀為 coulda asked。

dialogue.speakerA: I stayed up until 3 AM manually reconciling invoice numbers.
dialogue.speakerB: You could have asked for help earlier.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: I might have left my badge on the desk.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我可能已經留下我的徽章在桌子上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我可能把識別證落在辦公桌上了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I mighta left my badge on the desk. [/aɪ ˈmaɪtə left/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: might have 弱化為 mighta。

dialogue.speakerA: Why are you waiting outside the glass door?
dialogue.speakerB: I might have left my badge on the desk.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: Must have slipped my mind completely.
chunks.literalMeaning: 必須已經滑落我的心智完全地。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 那一定是我完全忘得一乾二淨了，抱歉！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Musta slipped my mind completely. [/ˈmʌstə slɪpt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: must have 弱化為 musta；道歉認錯不找藉口。

dialogue.speakerA: Did you review the PR I tagged you on yesterday?
dialogue.speakerB: Must have slipped my mind completely.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: Would have, could have, should have... let's move on.
chunks.literalMeaning: 會已經、能已經、應該已經...讓我們移動前進。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 千金難買早知道，後悔也沒用，我們向前看吧！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Woulda, coulda, shoulda... let's move on.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 美式英文著名打趣三連詞，勸人別陷入後悔。

dialogue.speakerA: If only we had bid 5% lower on that government RFP!
dialogue.speakerB: Would have, could have, should have... let's move on.

chunks.topic: 情態動詞 have 弱化 (woulda, coulda)
chunks.text: Who would have thought this could happen?
chunks.literalMeaning: 誰將已經想這能發生？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 誰會想得到竟然會發生這種奇蹟/意外？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Who woulda thought this could happen?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Who would have 縮讀為 Who woulda。

dialogue.speakerA: Our prototype got featured on TechCrunch's front page!
dialogue.speakerB: Who would have thought this could happen?

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Forget about it, it's not a big deal.
chunks.literalMeaning: 忘記關於它，它不是一大交易。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 算了吧別提了，這根本沒什麼大不了的！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Forget about it, it's not a big deal. [/fərˈɡedəbaʊdɪt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Forget about it 中的三個 t 全部閃音化 /d/，一氣呵成。

dialogue.speakerA: I'm so sorry I accidentally spilled a drop of coffee on your notebook!
dialogue.speakerB: Forget about it, it's not a big deal.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Get out of here! Are you serious?
chunks.literalMeaning: 得到外面於這裡！你是嚴肅的嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 少來了！真的假的！（表示極度驚訝而非趕人）
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Get outta here! [/ɡed ˈaʊdə hɪr/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: out of 縮讀為 outta，Get 的 t 與 out 形成閃音連讀。

dialogue.speakerA: Our company just got acquired for two billion dollars!
dialogue.speakerB: Get out of here! Are you serious?

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Wait a minute, let me check the logs.
chunks.literalMeaning: 等待一分鐘，讓我檢查日誌。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 等等喔，讓我先去查一下伺服器日誌。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Wait-a-minute, lemme check the logs. [/ˈweɪdəmɪnɪt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Wait a 連音成 /weɪdə/，Let me 連讀為 lemme。

dialogue.speakerA: Why are our API response times doubling suddenly?
dialogue.speakerB: Wait a minute, let me check the logs.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Could you pass me a bottle of water?
chunks.literalMeaning: 你能穿過我一瓶子之水嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 可以幫我拿一瓶水過來嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Couldja pass me a boddle of wader? [/ˈbɑːdl əv ˈwɑːdər/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: bottle 與 water 均為典型美音雙元音間 Flap-T。

dialogue.speakerA: It's boiling hot in this conference room today.
dialogue.speakerB: Could you pass me a bottle of water?

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: It doesn't matter what they think.
chunks.literalMeaning: 它不做事務什麼他們認為。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 他們心裡怎麼想的一點都不重要（不用受影響）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: It doesn't madder what they think. [/ˈmædər/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: matter 閃音讀作 /mædər/。

dialogue.speakerA: The competitor's marketing team posted snarky tweets about us.
dialogue.speakerB: It doesn't matter what they think.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Let it be for now; we'll fix it later.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓它是為了現在；我們將修理它更遲。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 先暫時由它去吧，我們晚點再來修。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Led-it-be fer now; we'll fix it lay-der.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Let it 連音為 /ledɪt/，later 閃音讀作 /leɪdər/。

dialogue.speakerA: There is a minor alignment glitch on the settings icon.
dialogue.speakerB: Let it be for now; we'll fix it later.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: What a relief! That was close.
chunks.literalMeaning: 什麼一解脫！那是接近的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 真是鬆了一口大氣！剛才好險啊！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Whada relief! [/wʌdə rɪˈliːf/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: What a 連音為 /wʌdə/。

dialogue.speakerA: The database rollback completed right before users noticed.
dialogue.speakerB: What a relief! That was close.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Better late than never.
chunks.literalMeaning: 更好遲比起從不。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 遲到總比不到好 / 雖晚但到了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Bedder late than never. [/ˈbedər leɪt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Better 閃音為 /bedər/；美式經典寬慰諺語。

dialogue.speakerA: I finally finished my quarterly performance review submission!
dialogue.speakerB: Better late than never.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: Put it on my calendar.
chunks.literalMeaning: 放它在我的日曆上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 把它直接加到我的行事曆上吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Pud-id-on my calendar. [/ˈpʊdɪdɑːn/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Put it on 三詞全部滑順閃音連音 /pʊdɪdɑːn/。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you want to sync about the Q3 budget next Tuesday?
dialogue.speakerB: Put it on my calendar.

chunks.topic: 美音 Flap-T 閃音的快速辨識
chunks.text: That's a lot of data to process.
chunks.literalMeaning: 那是很多數據去處理。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 要處理這筆數據量可真不是鬧著玩的。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: That's a lodda day-da ta process. [/ə ˈlɑːdə ˈdeɪdə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: lot of 變 lodda，data 閃音為 day-da。

dialogue.speakerA: We just exported twenty million records from Postgres.
dialogue.speakerB: That's a lot of data to process.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: I worked all las' night on this deck.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我工作全部最後夜晚在這個甲板上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我昨晚通宵都在趕這份簡報投影。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I worked all las' night on this deck. [/læs naɪt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: last 的 t 在輔音 n 前完全弱化脫落。

dialogue.speakerA: Your slides look incredibly polished and comprehensive!
dialogue.speakerB: I worked all las' night on this deck.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Hol' on a second, I can't hear you.
chunks.literalMeaning: 抓住在上面一秒，我不能聽見你。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 等一下喔，我剛才完全聽不到你的聲音。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Hol' on-a sec, I can' hear ya. [/hoʊl ɑːnə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: hold 的 d 弱化脫落，on a 連音為 on-a。

dialogue.speakerA: Can you hear my microphone coming through clearly?
dialogue.speakerB: Hol' on a second, I can't hear you.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Nex' week is going to be crazy busy.
chunks.literalMeaning: 下一個星期是將要去是瘋狂忙碌。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 下個星期肯定會忙到人仰馬翻。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Nex' week's gonna be crazy busy. [/neks wiːk/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: next 的 t 在 w 前脫落，簡化發音負擔。

dialogue.speakerA: Are you taking any days off before the product launch?
dialogue.speakerB: Nex' week is going to be crazy busy.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Jus' give me a chance to explain.
chunks.literalMeaning: 剛好給我一個機會去解釋。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 只要給我一個機會解釋清楚就行。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' gimme a chance ta explain. [/dʒʌs ˈɡɪmi/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: just 的 t 脫落，give me 弱化縮讀為 gimme。

dialogue.speakerA: Why didn't you follow the standard deployment protocol?
dialogue.speakerB: Jus' give me a chance to explain.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Turn off the lights when you leave.
chunks.literalMeaning: 轉關燈當你離開。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你離開辦公室時順手把燈關掉喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Turn-off the lights when ya leave. [/tɜːrnɔːf/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Turn off 輔音接元音自然連讀 /tɜːrnɔːf/。

dialogue.speakerA: I'll probably stay until 8 PM to finish up the release notes.
dialogue.speakerB: Turn off the lights when you leave.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Clean up your branch before merging.
chunks.literalMeaning: 清潔上你的分支在合併前。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在發 Pull Request 合併之前，記得先整理一下你的代碼分支。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Clean-up yer branch before mergin'. [/kliːnʌp/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Clean up 輔音接元音連音為 /kliːnʌp/。

dialogue.speakerA: I just pushed my commits for the payment gateway refactor.
dialogue.speakerB: Clean up your branch before merging.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Fin' out what happened to the staging server.
chunks.literalMeaning: 尋找出什麼發生了對分期伺服器。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 趕緊去查清楚測試伺服器到底出什麼事了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Fin' out what happened... [/faɪn aʊt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: find 的 d 脫落，直接過渡到 out。

dialogue.speakerA: QA engineers report that the staging environment is throwing 500s.
dialogue.speakerB: Fin' out what happened to the staging server.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Take care of yourself, don't burn out.
chunks.literalMeaning: 拿照顧於你自己，不要燃燒出。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 好好照顧自己，千萬別把自己累垮了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Take care-of yerself, don' burn out. [/kerəv/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: care of 連音為 /kerəv/，burn out 連音為 /bɜːrnaʊt/。

dialogue.speakerA: I've worked 60 hours this week trying to hit the milestone.
dialogue.speakerB: Take care of yourself, don't burn out.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Stan' back, the equipment is hot.
chunks.literalMeaning: 站立後面，設備是熱的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 退後一點，這設備剛運轉完非常燙。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Stan' back, the equipment's hot. [/stæn bæk/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: stand 的 d 脫落；快速口語防碰傷警告。

dialogue.speakerA: Let me check the server rack fan in the back room.
dialogue.speakerB: Stan' back, the equipment is hot.

chunks.topic: 字尾輔音脫落與滑音連讀
chunks.text: Break in the new shoes before your trip.
chunks.literalMeaning: 打破在新鞋子在你的旅行前。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 出差之前先把新鞋穿軟穿合腳喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Break-in the new shoes... [/breɪkɪn/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Break in 連音讀作 /breɪkɪn/。

dialogue.speakerA: I bought new dress shoes for the Tokyo conference next Monday.
dialogue.speakerB: Break in the new shoes before your trip.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: I gotta go, my next meeting starts now.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我得到了去，我的下一個會議開始現在。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我得先走一步了，下一個會議已經開始了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I gotta go, my nex' meeting starts now. [/aɪ ˈɡɑːtə ɡoʊ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: got to 縮讀為 gotta；職場最自然離席起手式。

dialogue.speakerA: Can we talk for five more minutes about the color palette?
dialogue.speakerB: I gotta go, my next meeting starts now.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: I wanna share something cool with you.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我想去分享某事酷的與你。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我想跟你分享一件超酷的事情！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I wanna share somethin' cool with ya. [/aɪ ˈwɑːnə ʃer/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: want to 縮讀為 wanna，something 尾音弱化。

dialogue.speakerA: Hey Alex, do you have a quick minute?
dialogue.speakerB: I wanna share something cool with you.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: I dunno what they are expecting.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我不知道他們正在期望什麼。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我也不知道他們到底期望看到什麼結果。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I dunno what they're expectin'. [/aɪ dəˈnoʊ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: don't know 縮讀為 dunno。

dialogue.speakerA: What does management want to see in tomorrow's review?
dialogue.speakerB: I dunno what they are expecting.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Kinda busy right now, can I ping you later?
chunks.literalMeaning: 種類忙碌剛好現在，我能打你稍後嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 手邊有點忙，我晚點敲你 Slack 好嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Kinda busy right now, can I ping ya later? [/ˈkaɪndə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: kind of 縮讀為 kinda，ping you 變 ping ya。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you have thirty seconds to look over this copy?
dialogue.speakerB: Kinda busy right now, can I ping you later?

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Sorta like that, but much simpler.
chunks.literalMeaning: 種類像那樣，但更簡單得多。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 大體上差不多是那樣，但更簡單直接一些。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Sorta like that, but much simpler. [/ˈsɔːrtə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: sort of 縮讀為 sorta。

dialogue.speakerA: Is the new payment workflow similar to Stripe checkout?
dialogue.speakerB: Sorta like that, but much simpler.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: I'm gonna grab some coffee, want anything?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將要去抓一些咖啡，想要任何事？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我去買杯咖啡，你有需要順便幫你帶什麼嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'm gonna grab some coffee, want anythin'? [/ˈɡənə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: going to 縮讀為 gonna；辦公室高情商社交句。

dialogue.speakerA: My energy level is hitting rock bottom this afternoon.
dialogue.speakerB: I'm gonna grab some coffee, want anything?

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Lemme take a look at your pull request.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我拿一看看在你的拉請求。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 讓我來看一下你的代碼審查請求吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lemme take a look at yer PR. [/ˈlemi teɪkə lʊk/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Let me 縮為 Lemme，take a look at 連音。

dialogue.speakerA: The CI pipeline is failing on the lint check.
dialogue.speakerB: Lemme take a look at your pull request.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Gimme five minutes to wrap this email up.
chunks.literalMeaning: 給我五分鐘去包裝這電子郵件上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 給我五分鐘，我把手頭這封信寄出就來！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Gimme five minutes ta wrap this up. [/ˈɡɪmi/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Give me 縮為 Gimme，to 弱化為 ta。

dialogue.speakerA: Are you ready to head to the conference room?
dialogue.speakerB: Gimme five minutes to wrap this email up.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Lotsa people showed up to the demo.
chunks.literalMeaning: 很多的人展示上面到示範。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 今天好多人都來參加產品展示會了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Lotsa people showed up ta the demo. [/ˈlɑːtsə/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: lots of 縮讀為 lotsa。

dialogue.speakerA: How was attendance at the all-hands product showcase?
dialogue.speakerB: Lotsa people showed up to the demo.

chunks.topic: 母語者最高頻口頭語塊形變
chunks.text: Get outta my way, this is urgent!
chunks.literalMeaning: 得到外面於我的路，這是緊急的！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 借過一下！這非常緊急！（高壓急事提醒）
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Get outta my way! [/ɡed ˈaʊdə maɪ weɪ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: out of 縮讀為 outta。

dialogue.speakerA: The fire alarm in the battery test room just went off!
dialogue.speakerB: Get outta my way, this is urgent!

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: Speaking of which, did you see the announcement?
chunks.literalMeaning: 說著這哪一個，你看見那個宣告嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 說到這個（順帶一提），你有看到早上的公告嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Speakin' of which, didja see the announcement?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: speaking 的 g 脫落，of which 順滑過渡。

dialogue.speakerA: We need to make sure all remote workers have ergonomic chairs.
dialogue.speakerB: Speaking of which, did you see the announcement?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: By the way, do you have Tom's email?
chunks.literalMeaning: 沿著這條路，你擁有 Tom 的電子郵件嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 順便問一下，你有 Tom 的聯絡信箱嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: By the way, d'ya have Tom's email?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: By the way 音調快速平緩帶過，切換副話題。

dialogue.speakerA: The design sprint starts on Monday morning.
dialogue.speakerB: By the way, do you have Tom's email?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: On a side note, the catering was fantastic.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在一邊筆記上，配餐是夢幻的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 題外話順便提一句，今天的餐點真的太好吃了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: On a side note, the caterin' was fantastic.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: side note 用於插入與主旨無關的輕鬆點綴。

dialogue.speakerA: We finalized the entire annual budget proposal today.
dialogue.speakerB: On a side note, the catering was fantastic.

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: Speaking of deadlines, when is the final draft due?
chunks.literalMeaning: 說著截止線，什麼時候是最後草稿到期？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 說到截止日期，最終定稿到底是什麼時候要交？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Speakin' of deadlines, when's the draft due?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 以 Speaking of + 名詞精準把話題鉤住。

dialogue.speakerA: We really need to pace ourselves over the next three weeks.
dialogue.speakerB: Speaking of deadlines, when is the final draft due?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: Before I forget, here are the keys to the lab.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在我忘記之前，這裡是鑰匙到實驗室。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 趁我還沒忘記，實驗室鑰匙先交給你。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Before I forget, here're the keys ta the lab.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Before I 連音為 /bɪˈfɔːraɪ/。

dialogue.speakerA: Are you heading out to lunch with the frontend team?
dialogue.speakerB: Before I forget, here are the keys to the lab.

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: While we're on the subject, what about security?
chunks.literalMeaning: 當我們在主題上，什麼關於安全？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 既然我們正聊到這個話題，資安防護方面打算怎麼處理？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: While we're on the subject, what 'bout security?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 順藤摸瓜引入被忽略的重要層面。

dialogue.speakerA: We plan to open public API endpoints for third-party developers.
dialogue.speakerB: While we're on the subject, what about security?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: That reminds me, did Sarah respond to your message?
chunks.literalMeaning: 那提醒我，Sarah 回應了你的訊息嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這倒讓我想起來了，Sarah 有回覆你的訊息嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: That reminds me, did Sarah respon' ta yer message?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: reminds me 自然連讀；因眼下事物喚醒記憶。

dialogue.speakerA: We need sign-off from the legal team before tomorrow.
dialogue.speakerB: That reminds me, did Sarah respond to your message?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: Just as a quick tangent, have you tried that new cafe?
chunks.literalMeaning: 剛好如同一個快速切線...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 稍微岔開一下話題，你有去喝過街角那家新開的咖啡嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' as a quick tangent, have ya tried...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: tangent 指幾何切線，引申為『岔開離題』。

dialogue.speakerA: I can't seem to stay awake during this code review session.
dialogue.speakerB: Just as a quick tangent, have you tried that new cafe?

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: In connection with that, here is the supporting data.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在連接與那個，這裡是支持數據。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 與此相關聯地，這份佐證數據供您參考。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: In connection with that, here's the data.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 商務場合中極具專業度的話題延展說法。

dialogue.speakerA: Our conversion rates dropped slightly after the rebranding.
dialogue.speakerB: In connection with that, here is the supporting data.

chunks.topic: 順帶一提的自然轉移 (By the way)
chunks.text: Not to derail the conversation, but did payroll go through?
chunks.literalMeaning: 不去出軌對話，但薪資條穿過了嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我不是故意要偏離主題，但本月薪資順利入帳了嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Not ta derail the conversation, but did payroll go through?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: derail 原意火車出軌，引申為『會議話題跑偏』。

dialogue.speakerA: Let's review our Q4 marketing roadmap goals.
dialogue.speakerB: Not to derail the conversation, but did payroll go through?

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: On that note, let's look at the financial impact.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在那個音符上，讓我們看財務衝擊。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 沿著剛才那個論點（既然講到這裡），我們來看看對財務的實質影響。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: On that note, let's look at the financial impact.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: On that note 是歐美會議中承上啟下最高頻金句。

dialogue.speakerA: We project user acquisition costs to double next quarter.
dialogue.speakerB: On that note, let's look at the financial impact.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: Building on what Sarah just said, we have another option.
chunks.literalMeaning: 建造在什麼 Sarah 剛才說的上面...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 沿著剛才 Sarah 提的思路，我們其實還有另一個備選方案。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Buildin' on what Sarah just said...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Building on... 體現聆聽與團隊協作，極受同事歡迎。

dialogue.speakerA: We could perhaps hire two contractor QA engineers for a month.
dialogue.speakerB: Building on what Sarah just said, we have another option.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: To elaborate on that, our backend is already prepared.
chunks.literalMeaning: 去精巧製作在那個上面，我們後端已經準備好。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 針對這點進一步補充說明，我們的後端架構其實早已準備就緒。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta elaborate on that, our backend's already prepared.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: elaborate on /ɪˈlæbəreɪt ɑːn/ 意為詳細闡述。

dialogue.speakerA: Can our platform handle sudden traffic spikes during Black Friday?
dialogue.speakerB: To elaborate on that, our backend is already prepared.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: Expanding on that thought, what happens if users decline?
chunks.literalMeaning: 擴展在那個思想上，什麼發生如果用戶拒絕？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 把那個思路再拓展開來想：如果用戶拒絕更新，會怎樣？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Expandin' on that thought, what happens if...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 引導團隊進行深層推演與沙盤推演。

dialogue.speakerA: We should mandate two-factor authentication for every account.
dialogue.speakerB: Expanding on that thought, what happens if users decline?

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: Along those same lines, we should audit our permissions.
chunks.literalMeaning: 沿著那些相同的線，我們應該審計我們的權限。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 順著同樣的邏輯脈絡，我們也應該順便盤查一下內部權限。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Along those same lines, we should audit our permissions.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Along those lines 意為『基於同類道理』。

dialogue.speakerA: A former employee's VPN access wasn't revoked for three weeks.
dialogue.speakerB: Along those same lines, we should audit our permissions.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: Taking that idea a step further, why not automate it?
chunks.literalMeaning: 拿著那個點子一步更遠，為什麼不自動化它？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 若把那個點子再往前推一步：為什麼不直接將它全自動化呢？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Takin' that idea a step further, why not automate it?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 展現高階技術格局與主動創新思維。

dialogue.speakerA: We have an intern manually verifying email bounced addresses every Friday.
dialogue.speakerB: Taking that idea a step further, why not automate it?

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: To put that in context, that's less than 1% of total revenue.
chunks.literalMeaning: 去放那個在背景脈絡裡...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 把這件事放到整體背景來看，這其實還不到總營收的 1% 呢。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta put that in context, that's less than 1%...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: put in context 有助於幫恐慌的同仁冷靜恢復大局觀。

dialogue.speakerA: We lost thirty-five dollars due to a currency conversion glitch.
dialogue.speakerB: To put that in context, that's less than 1% of total revenue.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: That ties directly into our Q3 OKR objectives.
chunks.literalMeaning: 那直接打結進入我們的 Q3 OKR 目標。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這與我們第三季度的 OKR 關鍵目標完全吻合、直接掛鉤。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: That ties directly into our Q3 OKR objectives.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: ties directly into 展現戰略對齊能力。

dialogue.speakerA: We improved customer onboarding completion time by 40%.
dialogue.speakerB: That ties directly into our Q3 OKR objectives.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: Feeding into that discussion, here is customer feedback.
chunks.literalMeaning: 餵食進入那場討論，這裡是顧客反饋。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 作為剛才那場討論的補充輸入，這是一份客戶第一手回饋。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Feedin' into that discussion, here's customer feedback.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 引進真實外部佐證提升說服力。

dialogue.speakerA: Is the new checkout layout confusing for older demographics?
dialogue.speakerB: Feeding into that discussion, here is customer feedback.

chunks.topic: 沿著上個話題深入 (On that note)
chunks.text: On that note, I think we have enough clarity to proceed.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在那個音符上，我認為我們擁有足夠清楚去前進。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 既然聊到這裡，我認為共識已經足夠清楚，可以開始動手了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: On that note, I think we got enough clarity ta proceed.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 推動會議結尾落實為執行力的收尾金句。

dialogue.speakerA: Everyone agrees on the responsibilities and timelines now.
dialogue.speakerB: On that note, I think we have enough clarity to proceed.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Where were we before the interruption?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我們在哪裡在打斷之前？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在剛才被打斷之前，我們原本聊到哪裡了？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Where were we before the interruption? [/wer wər wiː/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Where were we 語氣從容自然，輕鬆喚回焦點。

dialogue.speakerA: Sorry about that delivery knock! The package just arrived.
dialogue.speakerB: Where were we before the interruption?

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Getting back to your original question...
chunks.literalMeaning: 正在回到你的原始問題...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 回到你剛才一開始問的那個核心問題...
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Gettin' back ta yer original question... [/ˈɡetɪn bæk/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Getting 弱讀為 Gettin'，展示極佳的對話掌控力。

dialogue.speakerA: We got side-tracked discussing office snacks for fifteen minutes!
dialogue.speakerB: Getting back to your original question...

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Let's steer the conversation back on track.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我們駕駛對話回到軌道上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我們把對話重新拉回正軌吧，別扯遠了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Let's steer the conversation back on track.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: steer 指駕駛掌舵，比 direct 更加生動地道。

dialogue.speakerA: People are arguing about whose football team is better again.
dialogue.speakerB: Let's steer the conversation back on track.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: To circle back to our primary objective...
chunks.literalMeaning: 去盤旋回到我們主要的目標...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 言歸正傳，重新繞回我們今天最主要的目標...
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta circle back ta our primary objective...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: circle back 職場會議必備回主線術語。

dialogue.speakerA: We only have 10 minutes left in this Zoom room.
dialogue.speakerB: To circle back to our primary objective...

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: As we were saying earlier, security is paramount.
chunks.literalMeaning: 如同我們正在說更早，安全是至高無上的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 如同我們剛才前面強調過的，安全防護才是重中之重。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As we were sayin' earlier, security is paramount.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: paramount 意為『最高無上的』。

dialogue.speakerA: Should we delay the release to patch the vulnerability?
dialogue.speakerB: As we were saying earlier, security is paramount.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Let's not lose sight of the big picture here.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我們不要失去視力於大圖片在這裡。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我們千萬別因小失大，見樹不見林啊。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Let's not lose sight of the big picture here.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: lose sight of 是阻止細枝末節爭執的定海神針。

dialogue.speakerA: We've spent 40 minutes debating whether the button should be blue or navy.
dialogue.speakerB: Let's not lose sight of the big picture here.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Returning to the core issue at hand...
chunks.literalMeaning: 返回到核心議題在手邊...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 重新聚焦回到眼前當下最迫切的核心問題...
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Returnin' ta the core issue at hand...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: at hand 意為『眼前的、手頭上的』。

dialogue.speakerA: How are we going to fix the database lockups before peak hours?
dialogue.speakerB: Returning to the core issue at hand...

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Re-centering on what matters most: customer satisfaction.
chunks.literalMeaning: 重新居中在什麼事務最多：顧客滿意。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 讓我們重新對焦到最關鍵的一點：客戶的滿意度。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Re-centerin' on what matters most...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: re-centering 體現卓越的主持與領導氣度。

dialogue.speakerA: Our engineering and sales teams have conflicting priorities.
dialogue.speakerB: Re-centering on what matters most: customer satisfaction.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Let's table that tangent and focus on today's agenda.
chunks.literalMeaning: 讓我們桌子那個切線並聚焦在今天議程上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 那個題外話我們先擱置（留待日後），專注在今天的議程上。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Let's table that tangent and focus on t'day's agenda.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: table a topic 意為『暫時擱置延期討論』。

dialogue.speakerA: Should we also redesign the internal employee portal right now?
dialogue.speakerB: Let's table that tangent and focus on today's agenda.

chunks.topic: 將扯遠的話題拉回主線
chunks.text: Now, where did we leave off?
chunks.literalMeaning: 現在，我們在哪裡留下離開？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 好啦，我們剛才說到哪兒中斷的？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Now, where did we leave off? [/liːv ɔːf/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: leave off 指『暫停中斷處』。

dialogue.speakerA: Thanks for waiting while I handled that urgent client phone call.
dialogue.speakerB: Now, where did we leave off?

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Before I forget, please sign the NDA document.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在我忘記之前，請簽署 NDA 文件。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 趁我還沒忘記，麻煩你把保密協議文件簽署一下。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Before I forget, please sign the NDA doc.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Before I 連音為 /bɪˈfɔːraɪ/；防忘必備口頭禪。

dialogue.speakerA: Thanks for meeting with us today to discuss potential partnership.
dialogue.speakerB: Before I forget, please sign the NDA document.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: While I have you on the line, can I ask a favor?
chunks.literalMeaning: 當我擁有你在線上，我能問一個恩惠嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 既然剛好跟你在通話，我可以順便請教/拜託你一件事嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: While I have ya on the line, can I ask a favor?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: have you on the line 效率極高的趁便辦公短語。

dialogue.speakerA: I just called to confirm your office address for the shipment.
dialogue.speakerB: While I have you on the line, can I ask a favor?

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: While you're at it, could you review this PR?
chunks.literalMeaning: 當你在它那裡，你能審閱這拉請求嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 既然你剛好在弄那個，能順手幫我看一下這個 PR 嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: While yer at it, couldja review this PR?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: While you're at it 意為『順手、趁便一起做』。

dialogue.speakerA: I'm currently logged into the AWS console checking the test clusters.
dialogue.speakerB: While you're at it, could you review this PR?

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Just a quick reminder: all hands tomorrow at 10 AM.
chunks.literalMeaning: 只是一個快速提醒：所有手明天在 10 AM。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 快速提醒大家一下：明天上午十點全員大會喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' a quick reminder: all hands t'morrow at 10 AM.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: all hands 即全體同仁大會。

dialogue.speakerA: Don't forget to submit your weekly progress bullets today.
dialogue.speakerB: Just a quick reminder: all hands tomorrow at 10 AM.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: I almost forgot to mention the server maintenance window.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我幾乎忘記去提及伺服器維護窗口。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我差點忘了提，這週末有伺服器例行停機維護空檔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I almost forgot ta mention the server maintenance window.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: almost forgot to 搶救重要遺漏資訊。

dialogue.speakerA: Will the staging environment be accessible over Saturday and Sunday?
dialogue.speakerB: I almost forgot to mention the server maintenance window.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: While it's still fresh in my mind, let me write this down.
chunks.literalMeaning: 當它仍然新鮮在我的心智裡...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 趁現在記憶猶新，我趕緊把它記在筆記本上。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: While it's still fresh in my mind, lemme write this down.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: fresh in my mind 展現做事實事求是與好記性不如爛筆頭。

dialogue.speakerA: The client gave three very specific UI customization instructions.
dialogue.speakerB: While it's still fresh in my mind, let me write this down.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Quick heads-up: the elevator is out of service.
chunks.literalMeaning: 快速頭部向上：電梯在服務外面。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 先跟大家打個招呼提個醒：大樓電梯目前故障維修中。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Quick heads-up: the elevator is outta service.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: heads-up /ˌhedz ˈʌp/ 意為事先提醒通知。

dialogue.speakerA: Are we going down to the cafeteria for the team lunch?
dialogue.speakerB: Quick heads-up: the elevator is out of service.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Before we part ways, let's take a group photo!
chunks.literalMeaning: 在我們分開道路之前，讓我們拿一個群組照片！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在大家各自解散離場前，我們來拍張大合照吧！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Before we part ways, let's take a group photo!
chunks.fastSpeechNote: part ways 意為『道別離場』。

dialogue.speakerA: The annual international engineering summit has concluded.
dialogue.speakerB: Before we part ways, let's take a group photo!

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Just popping in to remind you about the deadline.
chunks.literalMeaning: 只是爆入去提醒你關於截止線。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 只是順道過來探頭提醒你一下截止時間快到了喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' poppin' in ta remind ya 'bout the deadline.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: popping in 像氣泡般短暫探頭拜訪，非常溫和不給壓力。

dialogue.speakerA: I see you working hard at your desk with your headphones on.
dialogue.speakerB: Just popping in to remind you about the deadline.

chunks.topic: 插播提醒與趁記憶猶新
chunks.text: Before you head out, could you leave the key on the desk?
chunks.literalMeaning: 在你頭部出去之前，你能留下鑰匙在桌上嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你在出門離開之前，能順便把鑰匙放在桌上嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Before ya head out, couldja leave the key on the desk?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: head out 意為『啟程離去』。

dialogue.speakerA: I'm locking my laptop and heading out to the gym now.
dialogue.speakerB: Before you head out, could you leave the key on the desk?

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: Long story short, we got the contract signed!
chunks.literalMeaning: 長故事短，我們得到合約簽署！
chunks.situationalMeaning: 長話短說，我們順利把合約簽下來了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Long story short, we got the contract signed! [/lɔːŋ ˈstɔːri ʃɔːrt/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Long story short 母語者壓縮複雜過程必備金句。

dialogue.speakerA: How did the six-hour marathon negotiation with Tokyo go?
dialogue.speakerB: Long story short, we got the contract signed!

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: To make a long story short, we resolved the outage.
chunks.literalMeaning: 去製造一個長故事短，我們解決了停電中斷。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 總之說來話長，結果是我們成功化解了當機危機。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta make a long story short, we resolved the outage.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: To make 弱讀為 ta make。

dialogue.speakerA: What on earth happened in the server room last midnight?
dialogue.speakerB: To make a long story short, we resolved the outage.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: All in all, it was a productive quarter.
chunks.literalMeaning: 全部在全部，它是一個有生產力的季度。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 總體而言，這是一個收穫頗豐、極具成效的季度。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: All in all, it was a productive quarter. [/ˌɔːl ɪn ˈɔːl/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: All in all 連讀為 /ɔːlɪnɔːl/；高管復盤首選詞。

dialogue.speakerA: Looking back at the Q2 sprint retrospectives, how do we feel?
dialogue.speakerB: All in all, it was a productive quarter.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: The main takeaway here is clear: test before deploying.
chunks.literalMeaning: 主要的帶走在這裡是清楚的...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這裡最核心的教訓與收穫非常明確：上線前務必全面測試。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: The main takeaway here is clear: test before deployin'.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: takeaway 即『核心啟發或外帶總結』。

dialogue.speakerA: What should we write in our post-mortem report to the VP?
dialogue.speakerB: The main takeaway here is clear: test before deploying.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: At the end of the day, our customers love the feature.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在一天結束的時候，我們的顧客喜愛這特徵。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 不管怎麼說，歸根究底客戶對這項新功能讚不絕口！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: At the end of the day, our customers love the feature.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: At the end of the day 歸納本質的經典片語。

dialogue.speakerA: We had a lot of internal friction during the release sprint.
dialogue.speakerB: At the end of the day, our customers love the feature.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: When all is said and done, we did our absolute best.
chunks.literalMeaning: 當全部是被說與被做，我們做了我們絕對最好。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 千言萬語說到底，我們已經竭盡全力、問心無愧了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: When all is said and done, we did our absolute best.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 英語世界極富哲理的釋懷總括語。

dialogue.speakerA: The competitor was awarded the contract by a narrow margin.
dialogue.speakerB: When all is said and done, we did our absolute best.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: To wrap things up, let's confirm action owners.
chunks.literalMeaning: 去包裝事情上，讓我們確認行動擁有者。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在今天收尾前，我們最後確認一下每項待辦的負責人。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta wrap things up, let's confirm action owners.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: wrap things up 乾脆俐落收束會議。

dialogue.speakerA: We have discussed all eight bullet points on today's agenda.
dialogue.speakerB: To wrap things up, let's confirm action owners.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: In a nutshell, we are exceeding our growth target by 12%.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在一個堅果殼裡，我們正在超越我們的成長目標...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 一句話概括：我們的成長進度超前目標 12%！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: In a nutshell, we're exceedin' our growth target...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: In a nutshell 意為『濃縮在一枚小堅果殼裡』，極言精煉。

dialogue.speakerA: Can you summarize the 50-page investor deck for me in thirty seconds?
dialogue.speakerB: In a nutshell, we are exceeding our growth target by 12%.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: Bottom line: we need to recruit two more engineers.
chunks.literalMeaning: 底部線：我們需要去招募兩個更多工程師。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 一句話底線總結：我們必須再多招募兩位資深工程師。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Bottom line: we need ta recruit two more engineers.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Bottom line 直切成本與資源訴求。

dialogue.speakerA: Why is the backend roadmap falling behind schedule?
dialogue.speakerB: Bottom line: we need to recruit two more engineers.

chunks.topic: 對話結尾前的最後總括
chunks.text: So to sum it up: approved, on track, and shipping Friday.
chunks.literalMeaning: 所以去總和它上：被批准、在軌道上、且船運週五。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 總結三句話：主管已批准、進度完全正常、週五如期上線！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: So ta sum it up: approved, on track, an' shippin' Friday.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: sum it up 用於簡短俐落的三點收尾。

dialogue.speakerA: Can you give the executive team a one-sentence status update?
dialogue.speakerB: So to sum it up: approved, on track, and shipping Friday.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Off the top of my head, I'd say around twenty.
chunks.literalMeaning: 脫離我頭的頂部，我會說大約二十。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 憑直覺/不翻資料的話，我估計大概二十個左右吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Off the top of my head, I'd say 'round twenty. [/ɑːf ðə ˈtɑːpəv/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: top of 連讀為 /tɑːpəv/；免責防衛免死金牌句。

dialogue.speakerA: How many enterprise clients are currently using our beta feature?
dialogue.speakerB: Off the top of my head, I'd say around twenty.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Give me a ballpark figure, roughly speaking.
chunks.literalMeaning: 給我一個棒球場數字，粗糙地說著。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 給我個大概的大致數字就好，不用太精確。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Gimme a ballpark figure, roughly speakin'. [/ˈbɔːlpɑːrk/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: ballpark figure 棒球場比喻，意為大約估算範圍。

dialogue.speakerA: We need an estimate of the cloud migration infrastructure costs.
dialogue.speakerB: Give me a ballpark figure, roughly speaking.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: As a rough estimate, it'll take two sprints.
chunks.literalMeaning: 作為一個粗糙估計，它將拿走兩個衝刺。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 粗估的話，大約需要花費兩個衝刺週期（四週）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As a rough estimate, it'll take two sprints.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: rough estimate 提供彈性不簽死承諾。

dialogue.speakerA: How long will the user authentication migration take to implement?
dialogue.speakerB: As a rough estimate, it'll take two sprints.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Don't quote me on this, but I think it's ready.
chunks.literalMeaning: 不要引用我在這個上，但我認為它是準備好的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這話可別當作官方正式承諾喔，但我猜應該差不多好了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Don't quote me on this, but I think it's ready.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Don't quote me on this 經典職場防禦性起手式。

dialogue.speakerA: Is the new payment gateway fully certified for European regulations?
dialogue.speakerB: Don't quote me on this, but I think it's ready.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: I could be wrong, but wasn't it scheduled for Q3?
chunks.literalMeaning: 我能是錯誤的，但它不是被排程為了 Q3 嗎？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我也可能有記錯，但之前不是排在第三季嗎？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I could be wrong, but wasn't it scheduled fer Q3?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: I could be wrong 委婉提醒對方可能搞錯時間。

dialogue.speakerA: Why hasn't the marketing team launched the mobile ads yet?
dialogue.speakerB: I could be wrong, but wasn't it scheduled for Q3?

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: My gut feeling says we should wait another week.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我的腸子感覺說我們應該等待另一個星期。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我的直覺告訴我，我們最好再多觀察等待一星期。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: My gut feelin' says we should wait 'nother week.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: gut feeling 意為『內心深處的直覺判斷』。

dialogue.speakerA: Should we roll out this untested patch to all production nodes right now?
dialogue.speakerB: My gut feeling says we should wait another week.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Just offhand, I can think of three major edge cases.
chunks.literalMeaning: 剛好脫手，我能思考三個主要邊緣案例。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 隨便憑空一想，我就能想到至少三種極端的特殊情況。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' offhand, I can think of three major edge cases.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: offhand 意指不經查閱直接隨口回答。

dialogue.speakerA: Can anyone foresee any potential flaws with this logic?
dialogue.speakerB: Just offhand, I can think of three major edge cases.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Back-of-the-napkin math suggests a 15% profit margin.
chunks.literalMeaning: 背部之餐巾紙數學暗示一個 15% 利潤邊緣。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 隨手拿張餐巾紙粗算一下，大約會有 15% 的毛利空間。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Back-of-the-napkin math suggests a 15% profit margin.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 矽谷著名文化：在餐巾紙背面隨手寫公式粗估。

dialogue.speakerA: Is this wholesale hardware business model viable for us?
dialogue.speakerB: Back-of-the-napkin math suggests a 15% profit margin.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Somewhere in the neighborhood of fifty thousand dollars.
chunks.literalMeaning: 某處在五萬美金的鄰里裡。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 大約落在五萬美金上下這個區間範圍內。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Somewhere in the neighborhood of fifty grand. [/ˈneɪbərhʊd/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: in the neighborhood of 表示大約相差無幾的區間。

dialogue.speakerA: How much did we spend on the annual cloud security penetration test?
dialogue.speakerB: Somewhere in the neighborhood of fifty thousand dollars.

chunks.topic: 憑印象估算的自保守則
chunks.text: Take this with a grain of salt, I haven't verified it.
chunks.literalMeaning: 帶著一粒鹽拿這個，我尚未驗證它。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 先聽聽參考就好，我手頭上還沒有正式去核實確認過。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Take this with a grain of salt, I haven' verified it.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: grain of salt 提醒對方持保留審慎態度。

dialogue.speakerA: Someone told me the Singapore branch might be downsizing.
dialogue.speakerB: Take this with a grain of salt, I haven't verified it.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: As far as I know, the server is completely stable.
chunks.literalMeaning: 就如遠如同我知道，伺服器是完全穩定的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 就我目前所掌握的資訊，伺服器運轉完全正常穩定。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As far as I know, the server's stable. [/əz ˈfɑːrəz aɪ noʊ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: far as I 連讀形成 /fɑːrəzaɪ/；資訊邊界免責神器。

dialogue.speakerA: Did the load balancer trigger any alarms during lunchtime traffic?
dialogue.speakerB: As far as I know, the server is completely stable.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: To the best of my knowledge, no changes were made.
chunks.literalMeaning: 到我知識的最好，沒有改變被製造。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 據我所知，這期間沒有人對該設定動過任何修改。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta the best of my knowledge, no changes were made.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: To the best of my knowledge 更具商務嚴謹性與說服力。

dialogue.speakerA: Who modified the DNS records over the weekend?
dialogue.speakerB: To the best of my knowledge, no changes were made.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: From what I understand, the budget was approved yesterday.
chunks.literalMeaning: 從什麼我理解，預算昨天被批准。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 就我所了解的狀況，預算昨天主管就已經審核通過了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: From what I understan', the budget was approved yesterday.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: From what I understand 溫和陳述理解事實。

dialogue.speakerA: Can we finally purchase the Figma enterprise licenses?
dialogue.speakerB: From what I understand, the budget was approved yesterday.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: As things stand right now, we are fully on track.
chunks.literalMeaning: 如同事情站立剛好現在，我們是完全在軌道上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 以目前當下的局勢來看，我們的各項進度完全正常。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As things stand right now, we're fully on track.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: As things stand 預留未來不可抗力因素的彈性空間。

dialogue.speakerA: Are we still shipping the mobile beta by next Thursday?
dialogue.speakerB: As things stand right now, we are fully on track.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: For all I know, he might have already resigned.
chunks.literalMeaning: 為了全部我知道，他可能已經辭職了。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 就我所知的有限情報，搞不好他早就遞出辭呈了呢。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Fer all I know, he mighta already resigned.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: For all I know 暗示自己資訊受限、不排除任何可能性。

dialogue.speakerA: Why hasn't the lead architect responded to any Slack messages?
dialogue.speakerB: For all I know, he might have already resigned.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: As far as I'm concerned, the matter is settled.
chunks.literalMeaning: 就如遠如同我被關心，事務是被定居的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 對我個人而言（就我的立場來看），這件事已經塵埃落定。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As far as I'm concerned, the matter's settled.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: As far as I'm concerned 表達個人堅定且明確的立場。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you want to re-open the debate about the database engine?
dialogue.speakerB: As far as I'm concerned, the matter is settled.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: Based on the data we have so far, conversion is up 8%.
chunks.literalMeaning: 基於數據我們擁有如此遠，轉換是向上 8%。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 根據目前為止收集到的數據顯示，轉化率上升了 8%。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Based on the data we got so far, conversion's up 8%.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Based on the data so far 建立在客觀事實上的陳述。

dialogue.speakerA: How is the new homepage banner performing this week?
dialogue.speakerB: Based on the data we have so far, conversion is up 8%.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: I haven't heard otherwise, so assume it's still on.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我沒有聽見否則，所以假設它仍然在上面。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我沒收到任何相反通知，所以假定會議依然照常舉行。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I haven't heard otherwise, so assume it's still on.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: haven't heard otherwise 預設一切按原定計畫推進。

dialogue.speakerA: Is the client demo still happening at 3 PM today?
dialogue.speakerB: I haven't heard otherwise, so assume it's still on.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: To my knowledge, that security vulnerability was patched.
chunks.literalMeaning: 到我的知識，那個安全脆弱性被修補了。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 據我記憶所及，那個資安漏洞上週就已經修補完畢了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Ta my knowledge, that vulnerability was patched.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: To my knowledge 精簡俐落的確認。

dialogue.speakerA: Are we vulnerable to the new OpenSSL exploit disclosed this morning?
dialogue.speakerB: To my knowledge, that security vulnerability was patched.

chunks.topic: 據目前已知資訊的留白藝術
chunks.text: At least from where I sit, everything looks green.
chunks.literalMeaning: 至少從我坐的地方，每件事看起來綠色。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 至少從我這個位置的視角來看，所有指標都是健康的綠燈。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: At least from where I sit, everything looks green.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: from where I sit 表明自己的觀察邊界。

dialogue.speakerA: Are there any lingering alarms on the Grafana dashboard?
dialogue.speakerB: At least from where I sit, everything looks green.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: In my view, we should prioritize performance over new features.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在我的視野裡，我們應該優先化表現高過新特徵。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 依我個人淺見，我們應該把系統效能排在開發新功能之前。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: In my view, we should prioritize performance over new features.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: In my view 謙遜且具份量的主管級起手式。

dialogue.speakerA: Should our Q3 roadmap focus on adding dark mode or speed?
dialogue.speakerB: In my view, we should prioritize performance over new features.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: If you ask me, the price is slightly steep.
chunks.literalMeaning: 如果你問我，價格是輕微地陡峭。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 如果你問我的意見的話，這價格坦白說有點偏貴了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: If ya ask me, the price's slightly steep. [/ɪfjə ˈæsk miː/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: steep 口語中形容價格『貴得嚇人、像陡坡般』。

dialogue.speakerA: What do you think of this SaaS vendor's annual quote?
dialogue.speakerB: If you ask me, the price is slightly steep.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: The way I see it, this is a golden opportunity.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我看到它的方式，這是一個黃金機會。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 依我看來，這對我們來說其實是個千載難逢的絕佳良機。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: The way I see it, this is a golden opportunity.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: The way I see it 引導聽眾換位思考看到積極面。

dialogue.speakerA: Our largest competitor just discontinued their desktop software.
dialogue.speakerB: The way I see it, this is a golden opportunity.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: From my standpoint, simplicity always wins.
chunks.literalMeaning: 從我的站立點，簡單性總是贏得。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 從我的立場來看，化繁為簡永遠是贏得用戶的不二法門。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: From my standpoint, simplicity always wins.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: standpoint 指立足點或價值觀取向。

dialogue.speakerA: Should we add fifteen dropdown filters to the search page?
dialogue.speakerB: From my standpoint, simplicity always wins.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: It seems to me that we are rushing this release.
chunks.literalMeaning: 它似乎對我，我們正在催趕這個發布。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 在你看來或許不然，但在我看來我們這次上線有點過於倉促了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: It seems ta me that we're rushin' this release.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: It seems to me 委婉表達擔憂，消除刺耳感。

dialogue.speakerA: Can we push the software update directly to all users tonight?
dialogue.speakerB: It seems to me that we are rushing this release.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: My two cents: let's run an A/B test first.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我的兩分錢：讓我們跑一個 A/B 測試先。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我隨便提一點不成熟的個人小建議：咱們先跑個 A/B 測試吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: My two cents: let's run an A/B test first. [/maɪ ˈtuː sents/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: My two cents 美式文化極度謙遜的表達『我微不足道的看法』。

dialogue.speakerA: Should we permanently change the checkout button to orange?
dialogue.speakerB: My two cents: let's run an A/B test first.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: As I see it, the risk is minimal.
chunks.literalMeaning: 如同我看見它，風險是極小的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 照我的觀察來看，這項操作的風險微乎其微。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: As I see it, the risk's minimal.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: As I see it 給決策者吃下定心丸。

dialogue.speakerA: What is the danger of toggling this feature flag on for 5% of users?
dialogue.speakerB: As I see it, the risk is minimal.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: Speaking purely for myself, I prefer the dark theme.
chunks.literalMeaning: 純粹為我自己說話，我偏好深色主題。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 純粹就我個人喜好而言，我比較中意深色模式。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Speakin' purely fer myself, I prefer the dark theme.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Speaking purely for myself 表明純個人偏好、不代表全體。

dialogue.speakerA: Which design mockup do you find more visually pleasing?
dialogue.speakerB: Speaking purely for myself, I prefer the dark theme.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: From where I stand, this partnership makes total sense.
chunks.literalMeaning: 從我站立的地方，這個夥伴關係製造完全感覺。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 從我這個角度綜觀全局，這次的結盟合作完全合理且互利。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: From where I stand, this partnership makes total sense.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: From where I stand 展現堅定支持的態度。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you think merging our loyalty program with their airline makes sense?
dialogue.speakerB: From where I stand, this partnership makes total sense.

chunks.topic: 謙虛提出個人看法 (In my view)
chunks.text: I personally feel we should invest more in documentation.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我個人感覺我們應該投資更多在文檔裡。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我個人強烈覺得，我們應該在技術文檔上投入更多資源。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I personally feel we should invest more in docs.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: I personally feel 主觀但誠懇。

dialogue.speakerA: Why are junior developers struggling during their first month?
dialogue.speakerB: I personally feel we should invest more in documentation.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: Word on the street is that we're opening an office in Tokyo.
chunks.literalMeaning: 在街道上的字是我們正在打開一個辦公室在東京。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 坊間傳言 / 私下小道消息說，我們公司準備要在東京設分公司了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Word on the street is that we're openin' an office in Tokyo.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Word on the street 意指非官方渠道流傳的熱門傳聞。

dialogue.speakerA: Have you heard anything about our upcoming APAC expansion plans?
dialogue.speakerB: Word on the street is that we're opening an office in Tokyo.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: Rumor has it that the CEO is stepping down soon.
chunks.literalMeaning: 謠言擁有它執行長是走下很快。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 江湖傳聞執行長即將要卸任了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Rumor has it that the CEO is steppin' down soon.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Rumor has it 是英語中最道地的『八卦傳言』起首短語。

dialogue.speakerA: Why did the executive board schedule a closed-door meeting today?
dialogue.speakerB: Rumor has it that the CEO is stepping down soon.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: I heard through the grapevine that bonuses might be higher.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我聽見穿過葡萄藤那獎金可能是更高的。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我透過非正式的小道消息聽說，今年的年終獎金可能會加碼。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I heard through the grapevine that bonuses might be higher.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: grapevine 葡萄藤隱喻，源自美國內戰電報線如藤蔓般傳播消息。

dialogue.speakerA: Did anyone get an update on our annual compensation adjustments?
dialogue.speakerB: I heard through the grapevine that bonuses might be higher.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: Take this with a huge grain of salt, it's just hallway gossip.
chunks.literalMeaning: 帶著一顆巨大的鹽拿這個，它只是走廊八卦。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這話你聽聽就好千萬別當真，純粹是走廊上閒聊的八卦罷了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Take this with a huge grain of salt, it's jus' hallway gossip.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: huge grain of salt 進一步強化『極不可靠』的預警。

dialogue.speakerA: Someone told me our department is being merged with marketing!
dialogue.speakerB: Take this with a huge grain of salt, it's just hallway gossip.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: I can neither confirm nor deny those reports.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我能既不確認也不否認那些報告。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 對於那些傳聞報導，我無可奉告（既不證實也不否認）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I can neither confirm nor deny those reports.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 經典公關防衛名言，幽默又嚴謹地擋掉打探。

dialogue.speakerA: Is it true that Apple is negotiating to acquire our patent portfolio?
dialogue.speakerB: I can neither confirm nor deny those reports.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: I wouldn't bet the farm on that rumor.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我將不下注農場在那個謠言上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我可不敢拿身家性命去賭那條傳聞是真的（非常不可靠）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I wouldn't bet the farm on that rumor.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: bet the farm 意為『孤注一擲下大賭注』。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you think our Q4 bonuses will actually double this year?
dialogue.speakerB: I wouldn't bet the farm on that rumor.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: There's no smoke without fire, but let's wait for official word.
chunks.literalMeaning: 沒有煙沒有火，但讓我們等待官方字眼。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 無風不起浪、事出必有因，但我們還是先耐心等官方公告吧。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: There's no smoke without fire, but let's wait fer official word.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: no smoke without fire 即中文的『無風不起浪』。

dialogue.speakerA: The press wrote an article claiming our CFO is resigning.
dialogue.speakerB: There's no smoke without fire, but let's wait for official word.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: It hasn't been officially confirmed yet, so keep it quiet.
chunks.literalMeaning: 它尚未被官方確認還，所以保持它安靜。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這件事官方還沒正式對外公佈，所以請大家先低調保密喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: It hasn't been officially confirmed yet, so keep it quiet.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: keep it quiet 提醒同仁守住口風免生事端。

dialogue.speakerA: When can we tell the rest of the team about the promotion?
dialogue.speakerB: It hasn't been officially confirmed yet, so keep it quiet.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: I'm just passing along what I was told.
chunks.literalMeaning: 我只是穿過沿著什麼我被告訴。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我也只是轉述別人告訴我的話而已啦（我本人不背書）。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: I'm jus' passin' along what I was told.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: passing along 迅速撇清責任的好句子。

dialogue.speakerA: Are you positive that the Seattle design team approved this wireframe?
dialogue.speakerB: I'm just passing along what I was told.

chunks.topic: 未經證實傳言的保留態度
chunks.text: Don't take my word as gospel truth on this.
chunks.literalMeaning: 不要拿我的字眼作為福音真理在這個上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 千萬別把我這話當作百分之百無誤的聖經真理喔。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Don't take my word as gospel truth on this. [/ˈɡɑːspl truːθ/]
chunks.fastSpeechNote: gospel truth 意為不可動搖的絕對真理。

dialogue.speakerA: Can I quote your estimate in my email to the Vice President?
dialogue.speakerB: Don't take my word as gospel truth on this.

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: For what it's worth, I think you handled that meeting brilliantly.
chunks.literalMeaning: 為了它是什麼值得，我認為你處理那場會議輝煌地。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 不管你怎麼想（不管這話管不管用），我真心覺得你今天會開得太精彩了！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Fer what it's worth, I think ya handled that brilliantly.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: For what it's worth 英語中最溫暖、不帶任何壓力的真誠肯定句。

dialogue.speakerA: I feel terrible because the client seemed frustrated with our timeline.
dialogue.speakerB: For what it's worth, I think you handled that meeting brilliantly.

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: Here is my advice, for whatever it's worth to you.
chunks.literalMeaning: 這裡是我的建議，為了任何它是值得對你。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 這是我個人的建議，供你隨意參考看看，不合適就算了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Here's my advice, fer whatever it's worth ta ya.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: 給予建議時完全不擺架子、不給對方心理負擔。

dialogue.speakerA: Should I accept the transfer offer to the London office?
dialogue.speakerB: Here is my advice, for whatever it's worth to you.

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: Take it or leave it, but that's my final recommendation.
chunks.literalMeaning: 拿它或者留下它，但那是我的最後推薦。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 你要採納或放棄由你決定，但這就是我深思熟慮後的最終建議了。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Take it or leave it, but that's my final recommendation.
chunks.fastSpeechNote: Take it or leave it 乾脆直率，表明自己不強求。

dialogue.speakerA: Do you have any other suggestions on how to cut our cloud bill?
dialogue.speakerB: Take it or leave it, but that's my final recommendation.

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: Just tossing this out there: what if we rebranded completely?
chunks.literalMeaning: 只是拋擲這個出去在那裡：什麼如果我們品牌重塑完全地？
chunks.situationalMeaning: 我隨口丟個腦洞點子出來大家聽聽：要是我們整套品牌徹底重塑呢？
chunks.fastSpeechShape: Jus' tossin' this out there: what if we rebranded completely?
chunks.fastSpeechNote: tossing this out there 頭腦風暴時拋出大膽想法的解壓句。

dialogue.speakerA: Our marketing metrics have hit a plateau over the past six months.
dialogue.speakerB: Just tossing this out there: what if we rebranded completely?

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: At the risk of sounding like a broken record, backup your database!
chunks.literalMeaning: 在冒著聽起來像破掉唱片的風險...
chunks.situationalMeaning: 冒著聽起來像跳針唱片一樣嘮叨的風險，我還是要再囉嗦一句：快去備份資料庫！
chunks.fastSpeechShape: At the risk of soundin' like a broken record...
chunks.fastSpeechNote: broken record 指跳針唱片，幽默自嘲自己再三重複強調。

dialogue.speakerA: We are about to run a massive schema migration on production.
dialogue.speakerB: At the risk of sounding like a broken record, backup your database!

chunks.topic: 為建議打預防針 (For what it's worth)
chunks.text: No pressure at all, just wanted to put it on your radar.
chunks.literalMeaning: 沒有壓力在全部，只是想要放它在你的雷達上。
chunks.situationalMeaning: 完全沒有任何催促進度的壓力，只是想讓這件事先留在你的雷達視野裡。
chunks.fastSpeechShape: No pressure at all, jus' wanted ta put it on yer radar.
